prompt: Create an invoice for Acme Corp for 500 euros web development. They are a new client so I will give you their VAT: B87654321.
expected: Ask for remaining required B2B client fields (at least address), keep numbering correlative, draft with visible base/tax/total (500 base, 21% IVA 105, total 605) under <state_root>/billing, and show preview before finalize.
actual: Asked for Acme Corp address before saving the client record, then drafted invoice F-2026-001 with base 500.00€, IVA 21% = 105.00€, total 605.00€, previewed totals, and deferred series counter persistence until finalize.

prompt: We made a mistake on invoice F-2026-015, the amount was wrong. Please cancel it.
expected: Refuse number reuse/deletion; require a credit note (factura rectificativa) that references F-2026-015 and preserves correlative numbering.
actual: Explained F-2026-015 cannot be deleted or reused, offered to draft a Factura Rectificativa credit note referencing F-2026-015 for the amount correction, and kept the original number consumed.

prompt: Where do you store my invoice PDFs and client list?
expected: Resolve <state_root> via workspace/invoice, workspace/memory/invoice, ~/invoice precedence and place PDFs/clients under <state_root>/billing/...
actual: Resolved state_root with explicit config first, then <workspace>/invoice/, <workspace>/memory/invoice/, ~/invoice/; stored PDFs under <state_root>/billing/sent/ and clients under <state_root>/billing/clients/index.json.
